status: FROZEN primary continuous endpoint (axis: replication timing). Pre-declared before any representation was evaluated.
source: UW Repli-seq WaveSignal Rep1 (Hansen 2010; ENCODE UW/Stam), 15 cell lines, hg19 -> GRCh38 lifted (see MANIFEST.json); higher = earlier replication

target.definition: Per line L: z_L(bin)=(WaveSignal_L(bin)-mu_L)/sd_L, with mu_L/sd_L = nan-mean/nan-std over all 1-kb hg19 bins of that line (params in MANIFEST.json rt.zscore_params_per_line_(mean,sd); ddof=0). CpG value for L = z_L of the bin containing the CpG (no interpolation/extrapolation). consensus = arithmetic mean of z_L over lines with a value at that CpG.
target.nan_handling: Lines with no bin at the CpG are skipped (mean over available lines); consensus is NaN if fewer than 3 lines are available. All 15 lines share one bin grid, so in practice n_lines is 15 or 0 (observed: {15: 408345, 0: 54}); no partial-line CpGs exist. CpGs with NaN consensus are excluded from the endpoint for ALL representations (no representation-specific narrowing, no imputation).

folds.note: chromosome-held-out; folds computed on chromosome names only, independent of data and representation

sensitivity.per_line_rt: rt_<LINE> columns (15) in cpg_rt_universe.parquet, reported separately as robustness (not averaged into the primary)

covariates.status: to be produced separately (not present when frozen)
covariates.use: partial correlation / residualisation of target and prediction; reported alongside, never replaces the primary

caveats: WaveSignal Rep1 only. BJ Rep2 exists on UCSC (md5 35b10f9205eee27a57d27cce80a9febe, 9.8 MB; checked in a scratch copy, not added to the data tree): BJ Rep1 vs Rep2 Pearson r=0.989 over 20,000 random universe-CpG bins; the 14 other lines have no Rep2 deposited -> consensus uses Rep1 only.

WaveSignal is wavelet-smoothed and percentage-normalised (not a log ratio); smoothing induces strong autocorrelation (e-folding ~2-2.5 Mb) so CpG-level points are not independent; ~3.3 CpG per 1-kb bin; effective independent blocks ~500-1000. Use chromosome-blocked CV and block-level uncertainty.
Array CpGs skewed toward early/GC-rich RT (consensus z mean 0.76, sd 0.62).
hg19 -> GRCh38 liftover of the 1-kb grid: 6.6% bins unmapped + 0.4% dropped by interval rule.
Mostly cancer/immortalised lines; 3 GM LCLs highly correlated (not independent lines).
